folders-server.boundary: Folders OIDC validates public bearers. EventStore:Gateway:BaseAddress defaults to http://eventstore; the registered FoldersGatewayHumanBearerHandler relays a bearer only for an authenticated direct public mutation to the gateway that issues its command-bound receipt. This is not general downstream delegation. Workload validation prefers Authentication:WorkloadJwtBearer and falls back to Authentication:JwtBearer only when the dedicated section is absent; partial dedicated configuration fails closed. /process verifies the separate human receipt and expected eventstore workload. Query and Metadata policies are registered alongside Process and Project; registration grants no authority enrollment. Credentials and environment bindings remain external and unresolved.

folders-workers.owner: Folders; Platform binds the isolated inbound broker component
folders-workers.boundary: Existing isolated inbound component name is a conformance input; Platform must qualify broker, declarative subscriptions, concurrency, retries and dead letters. Shared pubsub remains outbound.

folders-ui.owner: Folders and FrontComposer; Platform owns confidential UI identity integration
folders-ui.boundary: Current options expose no ClientSecret key. The current bearer forwarding handler is source input; qualified confidential UI credentials and downstream delegation remain unresolved. Never use hermetic-test auth for staging qualification.

folders-sdk.owner: Folders SDK; consuming host owns transport and authentication

workloadJwtContract.validationRequirements: Before narrowing the receiver audience to folders, the shared JWT contract needs an issuer, at least one nonblank Audience or ValidAudiences entry and exactly one Authority or SigningKey. Authority mode requires an explicit supported asymmetric AllowedAlgorithms list and HTTPS metadata outside Development. Production forbids symmetric SigningKey even with AllowInsecureSymmetricKey. Every issuer/audience/algorithm/key/environment value remains unresolved here; secure proposal defaults are RequireHttpsMetadata=true and AllowInsecureSymmetricKey=false, and no grant or enrollment follows.
